title: PolicyDefinition
description: JSON Schema for validating governance policy definition documents. Policies define conditions, priority, and outcomes for the Policy Engine evaluation pipeline.

priority.description: Policy priority for conflict resolution. Lower numeric value indicates higher priority.

conditions.description: Conditions under which this policy applies to an action request.

scope_level.description: The agent scope level (0-4) this policy applies to.

action_group.description: The action group name this policy applies to.

target_resource.description: The target resource type this policy applies to.

time_of_day.description: Time-of-day constraint with start and end times.

outcome.description: The governance decision outcome when this policy matches.

approval_status.description: Current approval status (e.g., approved, pending, draft).

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last policy update.
